description: Two column-zero apt preference lines escape the workflow run scalar, invalidating the workflow YAML.
trigger: GitHub Actions parses the build workflow at commit 275.
expected_behavior: The preference lines remain inside the run block and the workflow parses.
actual_behavior: Pin and Pin-Priority start at column zero. The reviewer reports a YAML parser failure at the top-level mapping; the parent parses.

introductions.scope: The changed pin step adds the two unindented lines.

observations.source: Author finding unindented-pin-lines; reviewer confirms by parsing parent and changed workflow.
observations.reach: Entire workflow fails YAML parsing, before any matrix step executes.
observations.limits: Author ran only scalar indentation inspection; YAML parser result is reviewer confirmation, not teacher execution.

limits: Reviewer parser result retained in the bound verdict; parser transcript not supplied.
No Actions job or package transaction executed.

impact.rationale: The invalid YAML prevents the entire workflow from loading.
